Council votes to make Riverside buses free

Riverside City Council voted 7 to 2 on Tuesday evening to scrap fares on every bus route in the city.

Under the plan, buses will be free for all riders from 1 January, paid for by a parking levy on large retail car parks. Council leader Ana Ortiz called it “the biggest change to how people get around Riverside in a generation”.

Two councillors voted against, saying the levy would push shoppers to out-of-town centres. The transport committee will publish a timetable in December.
